place:loire-valley.hero_kicker: One river · several wine worlds · no single natural-wine school
place:loire-valley.thesis: One river provides continuity, not sameness. From Atlantic Muscadet to Savennières, Vouvray, Chinon and Sancerre, physical ground, legal origin, grape, wine form and producer history keep changing; the human equivalent is a set of overlapping family, work, advocacy, collaboration and succession lineages—not one Loire natural-wine origin story.

hero_facts.label: Atlas structure
hero_facts.note: five main components · one tributary branch

place_story.button: Follow the river, then break the line
place_story.kicker: The map is a sequence, not a carpet
place_story.text: Start west at Muscadet, cross the Armorican-to-schist hinge around Anjou, separate Saumur's tuffeau country, read Vouvray and Montlouis across the river, branch north along the Loir, then reset at the hills of Centre-Loire. Regulatory outlines stay active; the analytical components and terrain are context, never substitute law.
place_story.title: One corridor, six reading positions

place.intro: Atlantic west · schist hinge · tuffeau middle · sedimentary east
place.lede: The Loire is the continuity line. Each component place interrupts any attempt to make the river a single terroir or legal boundary.

grapes.intro: Melon · Chenin · Cabernet Franc · Sauvignon · a long second line
grapes.lede: Four major routes organize the corridor, while Pineau d’Aunis, Grolleau, Gamay, Côt, Romorantin, Folle Blanche and Menu Pineau keep the map plural.

people.intro: Five doors · a larger ecology immediately behind them
people.lede: Landron, Joly, Clos Rougeard, Tue-Boeuf and Bain do five different teaching jobs. Huet, Leroy, Mosse, Collier, Bellivière, Breton and others prevent those doors from becoming a canon.

culture.intro: Family · biodynamic advocacy · work lines · fairs · legal disputes
culture.lede: Human networks jump across the river sequence. Shared geography, importer or subculture never proves mentorship, collaboration or one movement identity.

rules.intro: AOP · mention · IGP · Vin de France · institutional scope
rules.lede: Rules answer bounded legal questions. They do not map actual vines, certify quality, identify a natural-wine philosophy or turn UNESCO's landscape into a wine origin.

grape_cards.copy: The western anchor: Melon makes Muscadet legible, while broad Muscadet, Muscadet Sèvre et Maine and the `sur lie` mention remain different legal questions.
Chenin crosses dry, sweet and sparkling forms from Anjou through Saumur and Vouvray/Montlouis, so the grape connects the map without flattening origin or wine form.
Cabernet Franc opens Saumur-Champigny and Chinon through separate legal and physical places, with Clos Rougeard and Breton providing different human routes.
Sauvignon crosses Touraine and Centre-Loire, but Sancerre, Pouilly-Fumé, Cheverny and producer-specific classification decisions remain separate.
A high-value route through the Loir branch and parts of Touraine; its presence is not a universal Loire permission.
Anjou and Touraine red-wine diversity stays visible behind the four main regional routes.
Cour-Cheverny gives Romorantin a precise legal door; CARTA does not turn familiar origin legends into ampelographic fact.
Menu Pineau—also governed here under its local Orbois name—opens Tue-Boeuf and bottle-specific Vin de France questions.

people.explains: How a western family estate can teach farming change and Muscadet structure without becoming the origin of natural Muscadet.
people.reason: Landron opens the Atlantic west with a source-pinned chronology and a precise warning: estate practice is not an appellation rule.

people.explains: How one estate can become an international movement node without making the movement equal to the estate or the region.
people.reason: Joly separates documented estate conversion and organizational founding from mythology about inventing biodynamics or defining natural wine.
people.who: La Coulée de Serrant and Nicolas Joly

people.explains: What survives—and what must be re-dated—when a multigenerational benchmark changes ownership.
people.reason: Clos Rougeard makes family history, red/white Saumur routes and ownership discontinuity visible without assigning an automatic natural-wine label.
people.who: Clos Rougeard across the Foucault-to-Bouygues transition

people.explains: How transmission moves through family, seasonal work, partnership and négociant fruit while each predicate and production stream stays distinct.
people.reason: Tue-Boeuf is the community/transmission door the first five need; Huet remains the first major producer immediately behind it for Vouvray and Chenin forms.
people.who: Clos du Tue-Boeuf and the Puzelat work line

people.explains: What an appellation conflict actually proves when cause, date, legal remedy and later labels are not collapsed.
people.reason: Bain is the eastern legal-literacy door and the correction to the viral claim that AOC rights were removed because a wine tasted too natural.
people.who: Alexandre Bain and a bounded Pouilly-Fumé control dispute

lenses.text: InterLoire's published operating scope, BIVC's Centre-Loire scope, the Val de Loire IGP, UNESCO's cultural landscape and CARTA's analytical region are not interchangeable maps.
lenses.title: Every Loire number and boundary needs a denominator

lenses.text: Worked for, collaborated with, influenced by, family of, acquired by and succeeded by describe different transmissions. Shared geography or reputation creates none of them automatically.
lenses.title: A network becomes useful when its edges stay exact

then_now.intro: A dated control dispute is not a timeless estate classification or a tasting myth.

now.label: NOW · classification literacy
now.text: Read AOP or Vin de France on the actual wine and vintage; neither category proves a production philosophy.

then.label: 2015–17 · the documented case
then.text: Bain's habilitation dispute concerned required control, and the Dijon administrative court restored his rights in May 2017.

then_now.title: Legal friction has a cause, a period and a remedy

groups.label: Pays Nantais origins
groups.note: Broad Muscadet and Muscadet Sèvre et Maine are separate governed areas; `sur lie` is a legal mention, not another regional synonym.

groups.label: Anjou and Savennières family
groups.note: Overlapping or neighboring Chenin contexts retain separate regulatory identities; sweet, dry and producer stories do not merge their shapes.

groups.label: Saumur origins
groups.note: Saumur's multiple wine forms and Saumur-Champigny's red-wine identity belong to distinct legal readings inside the analytical Saumur component.

groups.label: Touraine's separate origins
groups.note: Opposite-bank Chenin, Cabernet Franc and Cheverny/Romorantin routes remain different legal places, not one middle-Loire appellation.

groups.label: Vallée du Loir branch
groups.note: Two legal origins keep the tributary branch visible; neither is a polygon for the whole analytical Vallée du Loir.

groups.label: Centre-Loire origins
groups.note: Sancerre, Pouilly-Fumé and Pouilly-sur-Loire retain separate legal identities inside a distinct institutional and analytical component.

groups.label: Broad overlapping categories
groups.note: Crémant de Loire and Val de Loire IGP cover broad legal geographies; they stay below more specific active origins in click priority and never define the CARTA region.

rules.intro: The Loire is not a ladder. Read specific AOPs, broader overlapping categories and Vin de France as different legal questions; keep InterLoire, BIVC and UNESCO as separately scoped institutions or cultural geography, and never infer vineyard parcels from an INAO regulatory-area surface.

featured_connections.reason: The Loire supplies continuity while five tributaries reveal why the wine world cannot be one linear explanation.
One grape crosses dry, sweet and sparkling forms, several geological families and separate legal origins.
Jasnières, Coteaux du Loir, Bellivière and Pineau d’Aunis prevent the regional route from becoming a main-stem-only canon.

place:pays-nantais.hero_kicker: Atlantic west · Melon · nested Muscadet origins
place:pays-nantais.thesis: Pays Nantais is the western analytical component, not another appellation. Broad Muscadet, Muscadet Sèvre et Maine, the `sur lie` mention and Landron's estate history answer different questions.

place:anjou-wine-region.hero_kicker: Schist hinge · Layon · dry, sweet and VdF routes
place:anjou-wine-region.thesis: Anjou is where geology, wine form and legal classification visibly refuse one answer: Savennières, the Layon family, dry Chenin and producer-specific Vin de France routes overlap but do not merge.

place:saumur-wine-region.hero_kicker: Tuffeau country · Cabernet Franc · Chenin · time
place:saumur-wine-region.thesis: Saumur deserves its own component: two core legal areas, two major grape routes and a human story in which Clos Rougeard's 2017 acquisition and Collier's family work line must stay distinct.

place:touraine-wine-region.hero_kicker: Opposite banks · plural grapes · work and family routes
place:touraine-wine-region.thesis: Touraine is not a midpoint. Vouvray, Montlouis, Chinon, Cheverny and Cour-Cheverny keep legal place and grape roles separate, while Huet and Tue-Boeuf open different human explanations.

place:vallee-du-loir.hero_kicker: Loir, not Loire · two AOPs · a succession route
place:vallee-du-loir.thesis: Jasnières, Coteaux du Loir, Pineau d’Aunis and Bellivière make the tributary branch structurally necessary. It is not filler between Touraine and the larger regional story.

place:centre-loire.hero_kicker: Eastern hills · separate institution · precise legal friction
place:centre-loire.thesis: Centre-Loire belongs in the learner-facing Loire world without becoming an InterLoire subregion. Sancerre and the two Pouilly origins remain separate, while the Bain case is dated and cause-specific.

appellation:savennieres.hero_kicker: One slope system · three legal identities · Chenin
appellation:savennieres.thesis: Savennières is read beside Roche aux Moines and Coulée de Serrant without merging their regulatory shapes or making the Joly estate the whole appellation.

geographic_feature:loire-river.hero_kicker: Continuity line · not a universal explanation
geographic_feature:loire-river.thesis: The Loire organizes the learner's route. The Sèvre Nantaise, Layon, Vienne, Cher and Loir interrupt it with other hydrological paths, while the physical and legal wine worlds continue changing.

featured_connections.reason: Put hydrological orientation back beside legal geography, grapes and people.
One tributary branch changes the appellations, grapes and producer ecology in view.

classification:vin-de-france.hero_kicker: A legal classification · never a movement badge
classification:vin-de-france.thesis: Vin de France can sit beside specific vineyard reality, producer experimentation, grape rules, cellar-location rules, control events or deliberate wine-by-wine choices. The label alone proves none of those causes and says nothing automatic about farming or cellar practice.

then_now.intro: The same estate can have different legal stories by wine and period.

now.label: NOW · how to read
now.text: Ask which wine, which vintage, which rule and which decision before telling an appellation-exit story.

then.label: 2015–17 · Bain
then.text: The documented dispute concerned required control and ended with a court restoration of AOC rights—not a ruling that the wine tasted too natural.

then_now.title: Classification needs a cause and a date

featured_connections.reason: Le Brin de Chèvre keeps classification attached to one wine rather than the whole producer identity.

institution:renaissance-des-appellations.hero_kicker: Founded 2001 · advocacy network · not a region
institution:renaissance-des-appellations.thesis: Renaissance des Appellations turns Nicolas Joly's advocacy into a governed institutional edge. Membership can be authored only when the current entity and member record are pinned; philosophical resemblance is not membership.

featured_connections.reason: Separate the estate's dated conversion from the later international organization.
Place one advocacy network beside other family, work, ownership and legal lineages it does not contain.

producer:domaines-landron.hero_kicker: Pays Nantais · farming change with dates
producer:domaines-landron.thesis: Landron's first-party chronology makes a durable Muscadet door: family continuity, a 1987 soil-work turn, organic conversion from 1999 and later biodynamic certification. None becomes a Muscadet rule or an origin myth.

producer:coulee-de-serrant.thesis: La Coulée de Serrant connects Chenin, a specific legal origin, a dated biodynamic conversion and the 2001 organization. Atlas keeps producer, appellation, advocacy and attributed philosophy as four different objects.

producer:clos-rougeard.thesis: Clos Rougeard links Cabernet Franc and Chenin to a long Foucault history, then marks a 2017 acquisition. Domaine du Collier is a family/work branch, not the same producer after succession.

then_now.intro: A durable producer identity can cross a material ownership change.

now.label: NOW · current estate
now.text: The Bouygues family has owned Clos Rougeard since 2017 and the estate presents a current team preserving its identity.

then.label: THEN · Foucault family era
then.text: Eight generations culminated publicly in the Foucault brothers before the 2017 acquisition.

then_now.title: Continuity is not unchanged ownership

producer:clos-du-tue-boeuf.hero_kicker: Les Montils · transmission without a school
producer:clos-du-tue-boeuf.thesis: Tue-Boeuf connects family estate, organic farming, purchased fruit, Menu Pineau and a documented work/partnership route through Pierre-Olivier Bonhomme. It does not turn producer practice into Touraine law or every bottle into Vin de France.

producer:domaine-alexandre-bain.hero_kicker: Pouilly · a control dispute, not a tasting legend
producer:domaine-alexandre-bain.thesis: Bain's 2015–17 case establishes a mandatory-control dispute and a court remedy. Farming philosophy may be relevant producer context, but it is not the proven legal cause and later classifications require separate wine/vintage evidence.

then_now.intro: The claim is limited to the documented habilitation period.

now.label: MAY 2017 · remedy
now.text: The Dijon administrative court restored Bain's AOC rights.

then.label: SEPTEMBER 2015 · withdrawal
then.text: INAO withdrew habilitation on the stated basis of a required-control dispute.

then_now.title: Two dates replace one viral myth
